sql: SELECT SUM(payload), AVG(temperature) FROM readings WHERE reading_id <= 100000
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(payload) AS total FROM readings GROUP BY region HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY region ASC
SELECT reading_id, COALESCE(optional_ref, 0) AS reference FROM readings WHERE reading_id <= 100 ORDER BY reading_id ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 2
SELECT DISTINCT region FROM readings ORDER BY region ASC
SELECT reading_id, CASE WHEN accepted THEN payload ELSE 0 END AS chosen FROM readings WHERE reading_id <= 100 ORDER BY reading_id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT reading_id, LOWER(region) AS name FROM readings WHERE region LIKE 'U%' AND reading_id <= 1000 ORDER BY reading_id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(optional_ref), MIN(temperature), MAX(payload) FROM readings
SELECT reading_id, optional_ref FROM readings WHERE optional_ref IS NULL AND reading_id <= 100 ORDER BY reading_id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT reading_id, temperature FROM readings WHERE reading_id <= 100000 ORDER BY temperature DESC, reading_id ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readings WHERE region IN ('US', 'IN') AND accepted
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(payload) FROM readings WHERE reading_id < 0
